correctness.rationale: Exact normalized monomial matrix weights give a selfadjoint third-band self-commutator. Its n>=3 endpoint diagonal dominance reduces to 4P(n)/[9n(n+1)(n+2)^2(n+3)^2(n+5)] with P(n)=13(n-3)^4+235(n-3)^3+1502(n-3)^2+3896(n-3)+3192, and the three initial rows have strictly positive exact margins. This proves positivity for all 0<=|b/a|<=2/3. Alternating angular chains yield scaled quadratic-form limit 4-3t^2-4t(1-1/L), negative for some finite L exactly when t>2/3. The case a=0 follows from E_n<0; zero symbol is normal. Direct differentiation and telescoping establish boundary Jacobian and trace. The standalone checker passed from its actual local path; it is not used for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: There is a motivated finite-degree gap within a known classification program for nonharmonic Bergman Toeplitz binomials: full two-parameter hyponormality is subtle because off-diagonal terms, not just monomial tests, determine positivity. This theorem obtains the full coefficient and phase classification at a sharp equality endpoint, establishes an exact symbol-Jacobian equivalence in this concrete family, and provides explicit infinite-dimensional positive/negative certificates. It is a complete, natural low-degree classification rather than an arbitrary numerical substitution; its restricted scope and prior generic sufficient method are acknowledged.
